resolutionPatch.newContent:
"""Session token encode and decode."""

import logging
import time

import jwt

from .settings import settings

log = logging.getLogger("auth.tokens")
LEEWAY_SECONDS = 10
ALGORITHM = "HS256"


def encode(user_id: str, ttl: int = 3600) -> str:
    now = int(time.time())
    claims = {"sub": user_id, "iat": now, "nbf": now, "exp": now + ttl}
    return jwt.encode(claims, settings.signing_key, algorithm=ALGORITHM)


def decode(token: str) -> dict:
    claims = jwt.decode(
        token,
        settings.signing_key,
        algorithms=[ALGORITHM],
        leeway=LEEWAY_SECONDS,
        options={"require": ["sub", "iat", "exp"]},
    )
    skew = claims["iat"] - int(time.time())
    if skew > 0:
        log.info("token issued %ss in the future (clock skew)", skew)
    return claims


def user_from(header: str | None) -> str | None:
    if not header or not header.startswith("Bearer "):
        return None
    return decode(header.removeprefix("Bearer "))["sub"]

"""Search key normalization, used for indexing and for queries."""

import re
import unicodedata

from .db import get_db

_SPACES = re.compile(r"\s+")


def key(text: str) -> str:
    """One canonical form for titles and queries alike."""
    text = unicodedata.normalize("NFKC", text or "")
    text = text.casefold().strip()
    return _SPACES.sub(" ", text)


def index_product(product: dict) -> dict:
    product = dict(product)
    product["search_key"] = key(product.get("title", ""))
    return product


def rebuild_keys() -> int:
    """Recompute search keys for every product. Run once after deploying."""
    products = get_db().products
    changed = 0
    for doc in products.find({}, {"title": 1}):
        new = index_product(doc)
        products.update_one(
            {"_id": doc["_id"]},
            {"$set": {"search_key": new["search_key"]}},
        )
        changed += 1
    return changed

"""Receipt thumbnails."""

import io

from fastapi import HTTPException, UploadFile
from PIL import Image

MAX_BYTES = 40 * 1024 * 1024
SIZE = (512, 512)


def _read_limited(upload: UploadFile) -> bytes:
    data = upload.file.read(MAX_BYTES + 1)
    if len(data) > MAX_BYTES:
        raise HTTPException(413, "Receipt image is larger than 40 MB.")
    return data


def make_thumbnail(upload: UploadFile) -> bytes:
    data = _read_limited(upload)
    with Image.open(io.BytesIO(data)) as img:
        if img.format == "JPEG":
            img.draft("RGB", (SIZE[0] * 2, SIZE[1] * 2))
        img = img.convert("RGB")
        img.thumbnail(SIZE)
        out = io.BytesIO()
        img.save(out, format="JPEG", quality=85, optimize=True)
    return out.getvalue()


def thumbnail_name(original: str) -> str:
    stem = original.rsplit(".", 1)[0] or "receipt"
    return f"{stem}_thumb.jpg"
